what: Interaction parity checklist (VC-UXD-56). One row per capability of the professional baseline. 'today' is the state of origin/main f1351cff read on 2026-10-28 (code audit, TECHNICAL_SPEC §1). 'status' is filled by the review: met / partial / missing. Incumbent references are sources.md ids.

rows.capability: Command line: type a command, autocomplete, suggestion list, prompts with keyword options
rows.today: partial: Ctrl+K palette with fuzzy search over every command + generated forms; no prompt-driven entry

rows.capability: Editable aliases (acad.pgp syntax)
Repeat last command (Enter / Space / right-click), default values
rows.today: partial: 5 persisted recents in the palette

rows.capability: Transparent zoom / pan / settings during a command
rows.today: partial: wheel zoom works mid-tool; pan blocked

rows.capability: Absolute, relative @, polar <, # override, direct distance entry
Dynamic input fields at the cursor (length / angle, Tab)
rows.today: partial: ValueBox on 3D feature handles only

rows.capability: Live cursor coordinates in the status bar
14 running object snap modes, per-mode toggles, master toggle
rows.today: partial: 8 modes + grid, always on, no settings

rows.capability: One-pick snap override
Snap tooltip + Tab cycling + aperture setting
Grid snap on / off (free cursor)
Ortho and polar tracking toggles with increments
Object snap tracking (acquired points, alignment paths)
Snaps on true 3D vertices / edges / circular edge centres
Constraint inference while sketching (Ctrl suppresses)
Window / crossing by direction in 2D and 3D, click-click alternative
Selection cycling of overlapping objects
Select all / previous / invert / add-remove
Select similar / quick select filters
Noun-verb and verb-noun for every modify command
rows.today: partial: move needs preselection; modify tools pick their own

rows.capability: Pick filters edges / faces / bodies; hover highlight
rows.today: partial: sub-elements only inside cage / face-edit modes

rows.capability: Grips on 2D entities, hot-grip stretch with snaps and typed values, multifunctional menu, Space cycles move/rotate/scale/mirror
3D triad with typed values and pivot on snapped geometry
Copy multiple, rotate / scale reference, mirror, stretch, break, join, lengthen by clicks
rows.today: partial: offset, fillet, chamfer, trim, extend, explode, move by clicks; rest via forms; stretch/break/join/lengthen absent

rows.capability: Arc and dimension click tools; LINE chaining with Close / Undo
Properties palette multi-edit + quick properties
Match properties
Current layer, layer drop-down, layer states
Fully customisable keymap with presets
F-key / status-bar drafting toggles
S-key shortcut bar; mouse gestures
Vendor navigation presets; pan during a command
View cube (26 directions), orbit about pick point, previous view
3D mouse certified-level support
Preview / rubber band for every tool
rows.today: partial: draw rubber band + palette previews (120 ms debounce)

rows.capability: Prompt line with options, defaults, CLI equivalent
Rollback marker in the feature tree
WCAG 2.2 AA keyboard / dragging / focus
rows.today: partial: aria on panels; no audit
